::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** May 10th [1885]  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS Birmingham University Library
:::

My dear [Mrs Joyce](people/person_787.qmd),

I am sorry to say I must ask you to put off your kind visit till next week.

My [sister in law](people/person_1604.qmd)’s brother, [Charles Walter](people/person_1464.qmd), has been killed in Alderney by a fall from his dog cart.[^1]  He is to be buried on Tuesday, beside his [father](people/person_1461.qmd)at Winchester, and the relations will be in and out here to see the poor [invalid sister](people/person_1462.qmd) so that I cannot venture to have anyone here on my own account.

Next week will be free, except on what ever day they may fix for electing the High school mistress  Then I shall be very glad to see you

yours very sincerely
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: With envelope addressed to ‘The Honble Mrs. Joyce/ St John’s Croft/ Winchester’ and postmarked 10 May 1885.
[^2]: Frances (Walter) Yonge and Gertrude Walter had two younger half-brothers of their father’s second marriage of whom the elder was Edward Charles Lethbridge Walter (1854-5 May 1885).
